outcome: fetal complications (IUGR, fetal distress, meconium-stained liquor)
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women with low amniotic fluid index (<=5 cm) in their third trimester, grouped into primigravida (n=60) and multigravida (n=60).
finding: Primigravida women with low AFI showed a higher incidence of fetal complications, cesarean sections, and NICU admissions compared to multigravida women with low AFI.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was higher among primigravida women with low AFI (56.7%) compared to multigravida women (43.3%).
